text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san, I'm so sorry... 
I fell just one step short.
choice_data_list:
Still, there must have been plenty to take 
away from this!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you. 
I see. "Things to take away," you say.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. 
Reflecting on what this experience taught 
me 
is extremely important.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If your prey spots you on a hunt, 
you reconsider how you approach it next 
time—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And if you fail to start a fire, 
you pick different tinder or kindling next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hunting, camping, racing—they're all the 
same. How you 
apply what you learn determines your next 
harvest—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Then I will take this to heart. 
To make it the fuel that captures victory 
in our next race...!
choice_data_list:
Then let's have a strategy meeting for 
next time!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Then I will take this to heart. 
To make it the fuel that captures victory 
in our next race...!
choice_data_list:
Then let's have a strategy meeting for 
next time!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, I must thoroughly 
analyze today's race.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To that end, I will head into the 
mountains 
to reflect and face myself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So that next time, our prey will not 
escape!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It is a steep mountain 
that I failed to summit today—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So to stand atop the peak next time, 
let us draw up an even more meticulous 
plan!
